title: Northgate Memberships Tier Ladder
content:
The tier ladder of Northgate Memberships fixes, for each tier, whether it can be upgraded during a membership year, the official tier a mid-term upgrade moves it to, and the official tier a downgrade or a shortfall-guarantee claim moves it to.

| Tier | Mid-year upgrade allowed | Upgrade target tier | Downgrade target tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | No | none | none |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | Yes | Northgate Club Plus Membership | none |
| Northgate Club Membership | Yes | Northgate Club Plus Membership | none |
| Northgate Business Membership | Yes | Northgate Business Plus Membership | none |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | No | none | Northgate Club Membership |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | No | none | Northgate Business Membership |

## The ladder read row by row

- **Upgrade target.** The tier a mid-term upgrade moves to. Three tiers have one: Heroes Club and Club both move up to Northgate Club Plus Membership, and Business moves up to Northgate Business Plus Membership.
- **Mid-year upgrade allowed.** Student Club and both Plus tiers read No; they cannot be upgraded during a membership year.
- **Downgrade target.** The tier a downgrade or a shortfall-guarantee claim moves to. Only the two Plus tiers have one, each its own base tier: Club Plus to Club, Business Plus to Business.

## Pairings shown by the ladder

| Base tier | Plus counterpart |
|---|---|
| Northgate Club Membership | Northgate Club Plus Membership |
| Northgate Business Membership | Northgate Business Plus Membership |

The ladder never crosses segments: no consumer tier has a business tier as a target, and no business tier has a consumer tier as a target.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Heroes Club membership has Northgate Club Plus Membership as its upgrade target; the Club Plus tier, once held, shows Northgate Club Membership as its downgrade target, not the Heroes Club tier.
